name: How do you blend a drywall patch into an existing bathroom wall texture?

mainEntity.name: How do you blend a drywall patch into an existing bathroom wall texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching existing texture requires choosing between hand-troweled styles like knockdown or skip trowel and sprayed textures like orange peel. Achieving a seamless blend involves feathering compound edges out several inches past the patch and testing texture patterns on scrap board before applying them to the wall. Because bathroom light fixtures often sit directly above mirrors, harsh downlighting highlights uneven patches, making accurate feathering and sanding essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Technicians match the texture by feathering joint compound wide past the patch boundaries and using matching application techniques before priming the entire wall section.
